title: ageratina glandulifera
intro: Ageratina glandulifera, commonly known as White Top, is a flowering plant native to Mexico and parts of North America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and providing antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Ageratina glandulifera include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antimicrobial properties, which have been shown to soothe various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
